title: TiRex native-unit synthetic activation-swap pilot
execution: CPU, 4 threads, compile and flex attention disabled; public wrapper including uncertainty postprocessing; both TTA disabled

generator.matching: Same full multiset and last observation within each pair; shared normalization to mean -9 and SD 0.6 in log-variance units.
generator.background: AR(1) coefficient .92, innovation SD .3; independent across pairs, shared within pair.
generator.persistence: Recipient alternating low/high; donor same low/high values grouped into two runs, ending high before common last point.
generator.recency: Recipient positive burst early in motif; donor same burst later, followed by common quiet tail.
generator.recovery: Recipient noisy rising ramp; donor same values in reverse order before common last point.
generator.validation: Independently draw76 or180-point motifs with probability .5 each; amplitudes uniform .8..2.8, noiseSD uniform .04...3; recency tail window//6 rather than //8.
generator.limit: Global matching does not match recent means, slopes, autocorrelation, or all alternatives to named concepts. No real-market inputs or targets.

selection: Unique top absolute standardized donor-recipient activation contrast per family, pooled discovery SD across all pairs and sides, layers0/5/11 only, tie by layer then unit; family order persistence,recency,recovery.
controls: Four same-layer nearest squared Euclidean distances in log pooled-activation-SD ratio and log outgoing-weight-column-L2-norm ratio. Exclude candidate and zero scales/norms; tie by unit. Freeze before validation. Other candidates may be controls if selected by this rule.
swap: Replace one gated-FFN scalar at token63 with corresponding paired donor scalar, in both directions; all other components unchanged. Natural scalar does not guarantee hybrid state is on-manifold.
direction: For each selected unit freeze sign of discovery own-family mean((delta_recipient_median-delta_donor_median)/2); exact zero => +1. Freeze candidate and controls before validation model evaluation.

instrumentation.histories: First pair from each discovery family; interleaved recipient/donor, six contexts total.
checks: same-value patch equals baseline at each selected layer
positive affine activation invariance and forecast equivariance
exactly one hook call; temporary hook cleanup; token-to-output index arithmetic
instrumentation.relative_error_formula: max(abs(new-old))/max(1,max(abs(old))) for each activation layer and residual

inference.influence_null: At most half the generator's pairs exceed +0.001 oriented log-variance shift.
inference.advantage_effect: mean absolute candidate median shift over both directions minus mean absolute shift over four controls and both directions
inference.advantage_null: At most half the generator's pairs exceed +0.001 advantage.
inference.test: Exact one-sided binomial test against p=.5; strict exceedance, ties fail; Holm across all six claims at alpha .05.
inference.descriptive: 5000 paired bootstrap draws for mean intervals. All families and short/long variants reported; no secondary significance declarations. Baseline-contrast-oriented summaries descriptive only.
inference.quantile_crossings: Flag and report without rearrangement; no mechanism promotion if any own-family candidate or control crossings.
inference.interpretation: Numerical influence floor is not economic materiality. Passing influence only demonstrates local model influence on this synthetic generator. Passing control advantage adds comparative evidence; neither proves concept exclusivity, forecast skill, calibration, or trading value.

failure_policy: Stop before selection if instrumentation fails. Never silently relax gates or search additional layers/units after validation. Record corrections and reruns separately.
